investigationTitle: CRITICAL MARKET FINALITY & EVIDENCE POLICY AUDIT — REMAINING OPEN TEAM TOTAL BET
policyAuditConclusion: A Team Total Runs market measures single-team innings totals and contractually has requireMatchFinal: false. An immutable snapshot proving the relevant team innings is complete is sufficient to settle.
implementationFix: Enabled allowSnapshotFinality: true on MARKET_FINALITY_POLICIES.TEAM_TOTAL and added hasImmutableSnapshotEvidence: true in evaluateTotalsMarketBet.
